releases.name: v0.3.0 — OpenCode 2.x support
releases.body:
## Changes
- Add OpenCode 2.x support through the new plugin setup and tool APIs.
- Retain compatibility with OpenCode 1.x.
- Resolve OpenRouter credentials and provider settings from the active session in 2.x.
- Forward cancellation to OpenRouter requests.
- Update installation and authentication documentation.

## Compatibility
- OpenCode 2.x: 2.0.26 or newer.
- OpenCode 1.x: 1.18.33 or newer.

## npm
Package: @makcimbx/opencode-read-audio@0.3.0

## Verification
30 unit tests passed; TypeScript, Biome, build, and both plugin entrypoints verified.
